hooks.name: branchyard-session-start
hooks.description: Tell the session which Branchyard branches need an answer, and how many run or are ready. Silent without by on PATH or outside a repository Branchyard uses.

action.command: command -v by >/dev/null 2>&1 && by hook --harness kiro session-start || true

hooks.name: branchyard-prompt-submit
hooks.description: Before each prompt, tell the session which Branchyard branches changed since it last heard. Silent when nothing changed.

action.command: command -v by >/dev/null 2>&1 && by hook --harness kiro user-prompt-submit || true
